newsitem.title: UK: UK Conservatives no longer deserve trust-Blair.
newsitem.headline: UK Conservatives no longer deserve trust-Blair.

text.p: Opposition Labour leader Tony Blair on Wednesday castigated the Conservative government's record, saying that after "five years of betrayal and broken promises they no longer deserve the people's trust".

Speaking at a news conference, Blair accused the Conservatives of having broken 92 manifesto promises, imposing 22 new taxes, doubling the national debt and failing in their policies towards Europe, education and health.
He said that, if he had this record in office, "I would not have the gall to ask the British people to trust me again."
"The country knows there are two faces to the Tories. They say one thing before the election and do another afterwards.
"If the Tories get in again there will be nothing to stop them putting taxes up again and contiuing with the damage to schools and hospitals," Blair said. -- London newsroom +44 171 542 7950
